data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure step for step and in order (open hotels, type the destination and pick a suggestion, choose dates, search, set rooms and guests with Increment then Update, then sort and filter), but it is slightly vague on how the date and guest-count parameters map to clicks and on which filters exist, so building an automation from it would need a few small decisions.
